caption: The drawing depicts a formal estate garden and grounds plan. At the top center, there is a large, rectangular building shaded in a dark red color with a smaller attached structure to the right, both surrounded by a green lawn. Yellow pathways enclose and intersect the estate, with one main curved path running from the bottom center to the left and around the building. Surrounding the main structure are various landscaped garden areas. To the lower left of the building, there is a symmetrical oval area with a central fountain or statue shaded in gray, encircled by pathways and small green bushes. Below and to the right, two geometric, highly patterned formal gardens are filled with alternating patches of pink, red, and green. To the right of these gardens is a sectioned-off area with dark rows, possibly indicating vegetable beds or orchards, and there are more scattered trees and a large open lawn in the upper right. Clusters of trees are drawn in different shades of green throughout the estate, and the edges of the estate are bordered with more trees and shrubbery. Text along the bottom of the image reads "THE JOHN L. HAVEN ESTATE" and "THE BLACKWELL SURVEY 1860."
title: John A. Haven Estate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
